sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店做DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每晚都要带上300件最珍贵的藏品去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After blaming Russia for a major hacking operation last year.
sentences.zh: 在去年将一起重大黑客行动归咎于俄罗斯之后，

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: is sanctioning more than 30 individuals and entities after intelligence...
sentences.zh: 正在制裁30多个个人和实体，此前情报显示……

sentences.en: The Biden administration responded with extensive sanctions designed to punish its government.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府做出了广泛的制裁回应，旨在惩罚其政府。

sentences.en: They're some of the most punitive U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是美国近年来

sentences.en: measures taken against Russia in years.
sentences.zh: 针对俄罗斯采取的最具惩罚性的措施之一。

sentences.en: That did not happen this week, after the administration blamed China for a similar hack.
sentences.zh: 但在本周，当政府将类似的黑客攻击归咎于中国时，这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: President Biden is condemning China for a massive cyber attack, but so far at least not going beyond tough words.
sentences.zh: 拜登总统谴责了中国的大规模网络攻击，但到目前为止，除了严厉的措辞外，还没有采取进一步行动。

sentences.en: China's not facing any punishments from the United States as of right now, not even sanctions.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，中国没有面临美国的任何惩罚，甚至连制裁都没有。

sentences.en: Is that a mistake?
sentences.zh: 这是一个错误吗？

sentences.en: Asted Herndon spoke with our colleague, David Sanger, about why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 阿斯特德·赫恩登与我们的同事大卫·桑格探讨了为何美国

sentences.en: is taking a different approach with China.
sentences.zh: 对中国采取了不同的处理方式。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月21日，星期三。

sentences.en: David, what is this Chinese cyber attack that the Biden administration just came out and condemned?
sentences.zh: 大卫，拜登政府刚刚公开谴责的这起中国网络攻击事件到底是什么？

sentences.en: There has been so many of these attacks, it feels, recently.
sentences.zh: 感觉最近这类攻击实在太多了。

sentences.en: It's kind of hard to keep track.
sentences.zh: 有点让人应接不暇。

sentences.en: Sure, Asted, and it can be a little bit confusing because every time you turn on the TV or open the newspaper,
sentences.zh: 当然，阿斯特德，这确实会让人有点困惑，因为每次你打开电视或翻开报纸，

sentences.en: you read about another hack coming out of Russia or China or someplace.
sentences.zh: 都会读到关于来自俄罗斯、中国或其他地方的又一起黑客攻击。

sentences.en: Some of them are state-sponsored.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是国家支持的。

sentences.en: Some of them are done by private groups.
sentences.zh: 另一些则是由私人团体实施的。

sentences.en: And this one that the Biden administration was going after was fascinating because we learned that it was a little bit of each.
sentences.zh: 而拜登政府这次针对的这起事件非常引人注目，因为我们了解到它两者皆有。

sentences.en: So let me just walk you through what happened.
sentences.zh: 让我来为你梳理一下事情的经过。

sentences.en: You'll remember that at the end of last year, just during the presidential transition, everybody was transfixed by a big hack that was done by the Russians.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得去年年底，就在总统权力交接期间，每个人都被俄罗斯人发动的一场大规模黑客攻击所震惊。

sentences.en: It was called SolarWinds.
sentences.zh: 它被称为“太阳风”（SolarWinds）事件。

sentences.en: And it was very ingenious because it got into the supply chain of software that companies use to basically manage their computer systems, network management, things like that.
sentences.zh: 它非常巧妙，因为它渗透进了企业用于管理计算机系统、网络管理等方面的软件供应链中。

sentences.en: So about a month later, people discover that there is another hack or a hack underway
sentences.zh: 大约一个月后，人们发现又有一场黑客攻击正在进行，

sentences.en: involving companies that are running Microsoft software, particularly a system called Microsoft Exchange.
sentences.zh: 涉及运行微软软件的公司，特别是名为Microsoft Exchange的系统。

sentences.en: Microsoft dug into it.
sentences.zh: 微软对此进行了深入调查。

sentences.en: And the more that some of other investigators did, they discovered that there were breaches all over the place.
sentences.zh: 随着其他调查人员的深入挖掘，他们发现到处都是漏洞。

sentences.en: And while they initially thought it was the Russians, ultimately they traced it back to China's Ministry of State Security,
sentences.zh: 虽然他们最初认为是俄罗斯人所为，但最终他们将其追溯到了中国国家安全部，

sentences.en: which is the main intelligence unit run by the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 这是中国政府运行的主要情报部门。

sentences.en: Microsoft says that Chinese hackers have been targeting its email server software.
sentences.zh: 微软表示，中国黑客一直在针对其电子邮件服务器软件进行攻击。

sentences.en: They gained access to emails.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了访问电子邮件的权限。

sentences.en: In some cases, they took over computers.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们还接管了计算机。

sentences.en: Upwards of 30,000 U.S.
sentences.zh: 超过3万个美国

sentences.en: entities were breached in the hack.
sentences.zh: 实体在这次黑客攻击中遭到入侵。

sentences.en: Universities, defense contractors, law firms, and infectious disease researchers.
sentences.zh: 包括大学、国防承包商、律师事务所和传染病研究人员。

sentences.en: There's enormous frustration, I can tell you, on the business and government side.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，企业界和政府方面对此感到极大的沮丧。

sentences.en: And so at the end of February and early March, they began sending out warnings to people that said, hey, we think we found an intruder.
sentences.zh: 因此，在2月底和3月初，他们开始向人们发出警告，说：嘿，我们认为我们发现了一个入侵者。

sentences.en: This intruder has found a vulnerability in all the software we've given you that we didn't know about.
sentences.zh: 这个入侵者在我们提供的所有软件中发现了一个我们之前未知的漏洞。

sentences.en: The company released a patch protecting users from similar future hacks.
sentences.zh: 该公司发布了一个补丁，以保护用户免受未来类似黑客攻击的影响。

sentences.en: However, the patch does not fix issues for those who already have their network breached.
sentences.zh: 然而，该补丁并不能解决那些网络已经遭到入侵的用户的安全问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so this is the cyber attack that the Biden administration decides to come out againSt.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以这就是拜登政府决定公开反对的网络攻击。

sentences.en: That's exactly right, Estet.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，阿斯特德。

sentences.en: Now, do we know what China was after?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们知道中国想要什么吗？

sentences.en: It's a great question, and we're not certain, but in this case, there were so many companies running this Microsoft Exchange system
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题，我们并不确定，但在这种情况下，有太多的公司在运行这个Microsoft Exchange系统，

sentences.en: that it's hard to say exactly what they were looking for.
sentences.zh: 以至于很难说他们到底在寻找什么。

sentences.en: And they may not have known exactly what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能自己也不知道确切想要什么。

sentences.en: They may have simply known that this system is used by many of the biggest defense contractors, by many of the biggest companies in America, and once they were inside,
sentences.zh: 他们可能只是知道这个系统被许多最大的国防承包商和美国许多大公司使用，一旦进入内部，

sentences.en: they could look around and decide what was worth stealing.
sentences.zh: 他们就可以四处查看，决定什么东西值得窃取。

sentences.en: This strikes me as pretty brazen from an outsider perspective.
sentences.zh: 从局外人的角度来看，这让我觉得相当猖狂。

sentences.en: The Chinese government hacking Microsoft, one of the world's most important and integrated companies, into the global economy.
sentences.zh: 中国政府黑进了微软，这是全球经济中最重要、整合度最高的公司之一。

sentences.en: Is that how it was received, as a kind of brazen or bold thing?
sentences.zh: 外界是这样认为的吗，认为这是一种猖狂或大胆的行为？

sentences.en: It was brazen and it was bold.
sentences.zh: 这既猖狂又大胆。

sentences.en: We've seen that before, but it was also indiscriminate, and that was what was new.
sentences.zh: 我们以前见过这种情况，但这次也是不加区分的，这才是新奇之处。

sentences.en: Previously, when we've seen the Chinese go into companies or federal agencies, it's usually been a pretty specific attack.
sentences.zh: 以前，当我们看到中国进入公司或联邦机构时，通常都是非常有针对性的攻击。

sentences.en: In this case, they just went into everybody's systems and said, once we're inside, we'll figure out what we want.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们只是进入了所有人的系统，并说：一旦进去，我们再决定想要什么。

sentences.en: So, the Biden administration knew from the start that this was China.
sentences.zh: 所以，拜登政府从一开始就知道这是中国所为。

sentences.en: Microsoft had said it.
sentences.zh: 微软已经说过了。

sentences.en: Their own intelligence agencies were pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 他们自己的情报机构也相当明确。

sentences.en: They understood the Chinese had exploited a vulnerability that no one knew existed in the Microsoft software.
sentences.zh: 他们明白中国人利用了微软软件中一个无人知晓的漏洞。

sentences.en: And since the attack had hit many different countries, they decided to go use it as a way
sentences.zh: 由于这次攻击波及了许多不同的国家，他们决定以此为契机，

sentences.en: to try to show China that the rest of the world, or at least the rest of the Western alliance,
sentences.zh: 试图向中国展示世界其他地区，或者至少是西方联盟的其他成员，

sentences.en: was lined up against them on these cyber attacks in a way that we had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 在这些网络攻击问题上正以前所未有的方式联合起来反对他们。

sentences.en: So, they began going around the world, going to countries like Germany, which had seen probably the second largest number of attacks and information losses under this,
sentences.zh: 因此，他们开始走访世界各地，前往德国等国家（德国在此次事件中遭受的攻击和信息损失数量可能位居第二），

sentences.en: taking the evidence to them, and tried to get everyone, including all of the NATO nations, lined up to go condemn China simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 向他们出示证据，并试图让包括所有北约国家在内的所有人联合起来，同时谴责中国。

sentences.en: Now, that doesn't sound like a big deal, but it is one.
sentences.zh: 这听起来可能没什么大不了的，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Because, believe it or not, NATO is still so back in the world of old traditional threats that they had never actually condemned a cyber attack,
sentences.zh: 因为信不信由你，北约仍然沉浸在传统的旧威胁世界中，以至于他们从未真正谴责过网络攻击，

sentences.en: even though cyber attacks have hit their member nations for years and years.
sentences.zh: 尽管网络攻击多年来一直困扰着他们的成员国。

sentences.en: Wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等。

sentences.en: NATO has never condemned a cyber attack before?
sentences.zh: 北约以前从未谴责过网络攻击？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was the first time.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次。

sentences.en: That feels shocking.
sentences.zh: 这让人感到震惊。

sentences.en: Well, it tells you a little bit about how so much of the Western alliance is still stuck in the old threats.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这说明了西方联盟在多大程度上仍然被旧有的威胁所困扰。

sentences.en: So, it's been a real slog to get them to think about cyber attacks the same way they would think about military attacks.
sentences.zh: 所以，要让他们像看待军事攻击一样看待网络攻击，确实是一场艰苦的斗争。

sentences.en: So, part of the effort here was just to get the diplomacy to catch up with the technology.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里的部分努力只是为了让外交手段跟上技术的发展。

sentences.en: And what happened here was that the United States basically convinced the European nations, members of NATO, Japan, Australia, others, that if you let this go unchecked,
sentences.zh: 而这里发生的事情是，美国基本上说服了欧洲国家、北约成员国、日本、澳大利亚和其他国家，如果任由这种情况发展而不加制止，

sentences.en: the Chinese would, over time, use techniques like this to get into all of their systeMs.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，中国人会利用这种技术渗透进他们所有的系统。

sentences.en: So, once the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦美国

sentences.en: and these other countries agreed to actually condemn China, what did they end up saying?
sentences.zh: 和其他国家同意真正谴责中国，他们最终说了什么？

sentences.en: Well, they were all a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们的说法都略有不同。

sentences.en: The United States really took the lead on this since it got the brunt of the attack.
sentences.zh: 美国确实在此事上发挥了主导作用，因为它遭受了攻击的重创。

sentences.en: And they directly accused the Ministry of State Security of being behind this specific hack.
sentences.zh: 他们直接指责国家安全部是这次特定黑客攻击的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: But then they went further, and they said, we also found evidence that the Chinese Ministry of State Security wasn't only operating by itself,
sentences.zh: 但他们更进一步，表示我们还发现了证据，证明中国国家安全部不仅在单独行动，

sentences.en: but that it was condoning and, in some cases, financing criminal hacking groups and letting them run out of China,
sentences.zh: 而且还在纵容，在某些情况下甚至资助犯罪黑客组织，并允许他们在国内运作，

sentences.en: which is a charge that, in the past, we've really only made about Russia.
sentences.zh: 这在过去是我们只针对俄罗斯提出的指控。

sentences.en: Now, other countries, including NATO, they weren't as specific, in part because they can't see the kind of evidence the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，其他国家，包括北约，并没有那么具体，部分原因是他们无法看到美国所掌握的那种证据。

sentences.en: does.
sentences.zh: 因此，大多数欧洲国家只是简单地表示，他们谴责中国在网络空间的活动，并敦促他们在这一领域遵守国际法，

sentences.en: So, most of the Europeans said simply that they were condemning Chinese activity in cyberspace and urging them to respect international law in this area
sentences.zh: 而没有具体指控他们对这次个别黑客攻击负有责任。

sentences.en: without specifically accusing them of guilt in this individual hack.
sentences.zh: 那么，对于周一针对这次黑客攻击发出的这种协调一致的多国谴责，中国是如何回应的呢？

sentences.en: So, how did China, then, respond to this coordinated, multinational condemnation that came out on Monday for this hack?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有意思，因为这是一种不屑一顾

sentences.en: Well, instead, it was fascinating because it was a combination of dismissiveness
sentences.zh: 与反击美国自身网络行动的结合。

sentences.en: and a counterattack on the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: for its own cyber operations.
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 在不屑一顾方面，他们说：哦，我们一直从美国人那里听到这些。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 他们不断地做出这样的指控。

sentences.en: On the dismissive side, they said, oh, we hear this from the Americans all the time.
sentences.zh: 他们从来没有真正拿出证据。

sentences.en: They're constantly making accusations like this.
sentences.zh: 谁会相信这个？

sentences.en: They're never really putting out the evidence.
sentences.zh: 但中国接下来做的事情，他们说，非常引人注目。

sentences.en: Who can believe this?
sentences.zh: 他们说：你知道，如果你想谈论网络罪犯，为什么不先看看你们自己呢，美国？

sentences.en: But the next thing the Chinese did, they said, was really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 他们说：还记得斯诺登的披露吗？

sentences.en: And they said, you know, if you want to talk about cyber criminals, why don't you start looking at yourselves, America?
sentences.zh: 当然，那已经是七八年前的事了。

sentences.en: They said, remember the Snowden disclosures?
sentences.zh: 在斯诺登时代，我们学到了什么？

sentences.en: And, of course, that's going back now seven, eight years.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，正是美国在进入外国计算机系统，进行着你们今天指责中国所做的那种监视。

sentences.en: And in the Snowden era, what did we learn?
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们在这方面很有道理。

sentences.en: We learned that it was the United States that was going into foreign computer systems, conducting exactly the kind of surveillance you're accusing China of doing today.
sentences.zh: 因为虽然斯诺登谈到了揭露政府对美国人私人通信的入侵，但斯诺登文件中所有最有趣的内容

sentences.en: And, in fact, they have a pretty good case to make there.
sentences.zh: 实际上显示，国家安全局（NSA）和后来成为美国网络司令部的机构，确实入侵了包括中国在内的外国计算机系统。

sentences.en: Because while Snowden talked about revealing government intrusions into the private communications of Americans, all of the most interesting stuff in the Snowden documents
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们针对中国大型电信巨头华为，进入了他们的计算机系统，弄清楚了他们的系统是如何运作的，以防美国

sentences.en: actually showed that the National Security Agency and what later became United States Cyber Command broke into foreign computer systems, including China's.
sentences.zh: 将来需要反制这些系统。

sentences.en: In fact, they went after Huawei, the big Chinese telecommunications giant, got into their computer systems, figured out how their systems worked in case the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都在斯诺登的文件中。

sentences.en: ever needed to counter those systeMs.
sentences.zh: 所以中国人说：嘿，如果有人发明了入侵外国企业系统并从中提取数据的游戏，

sentences.en: And this was all in the Snowden docs.
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么不先看看米德堡（Fort Meade）呢？那是国家安全局的所在地，就在巴尔的摩-华盛顿机场附近。

sentences.en: And so the Chinese were saying, hey, if anybody invented the game of breaking into foreign corporate systems and extracting data from them,
sentences.zh: 所以看来，一方面，西方大多数国家在谴责中国，称其为美国所描述的独特且不加区分的猖狂网络攻击。

sentences.en: well, why don't you start looking at Fort Meade, which is where the NSA is located, just up near the Baltimore-Washington airport.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面，中国政府并没有退缩，反而反过来指责美国。

sentences.en: So it seems we have, on the one hand, most of the West condemning China for what the United States is describing as a uniquely indiscriminate and brazen cyber attack.
sentences.zh: 你这里所拥有的是一个升级和进一步对抗的公式。

sentences.en: And on the other hand, you have a Chinese government that is not backing down and is, in turn, pointing fingers back at the United States.
sentences.zh: 当你处理世界第一大经济体和世界第二大经济体之间的关系时，这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: What you have here is a formula for escalation and further confrontation.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And that's a big problem when you're dealing with the world's largest economy and the world's second largest economy.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、
